chunks: And Dharih al-Muharibi narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
Regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic,
"Then let them complete their prescribed duties."
He said: "Al-tafath is meeting the Imam."

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.التَّفَثُ: al-tafath, explained by the Imam in this narration
key_terms.تَفَثَهُمْ: their tafath; here interpreted in an inner sense rather than only an outward ritual sense
key_terms.ذَرِيحٌ الْمُحَارِبِيُّ: Dharih al-Muharibi, the narrator transmitting this report
key_terms.قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: the statement of Allah, referring to the Qur'anic verse being interpreted
key_terms.لِقَاءُ الْإِمَامِ: meeting the Imam, identified here as the meaning of al-tafath

ai.seo_question: What does "ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوا تَفَثَهُمْ" mean according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith presents an interpretation of the Qur'anic phrase "ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوا تَفَثَهُمْ" by Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام. It explains that the deeper meaning of al-tafath is the meeting of the Imam, linking the rites of hajj with recognition of divinely appointed religious authority.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3031 - Dharih al-Muharibi narrated from Abu Abdullah (as)
regarding the saying of Allah (swt), the Almighty
: "Then let them complete their prescribed duties"

(Surah Al-Hajj 22:29).
Imam (as) said: "The prescribed duties refer to meeting the Imam."
